description: Search Swiss parliamentary business by title substring, published submitter label, type, current status, submission session, inclusive submission dates, committee role, a member's own roles (personNumber, optionally one role such as author or cosignatory), or topic tag (tagId; without committeeId or personNumber it needs a submission-date window of at most 366 days). Use chparl_list_reference to resolve codes and chparl_get_business to read a returned businessId. Follow nextCursor with unchanged filters; newest canonical business IDs appear first. Author searches omit the business total. Committee searches, and personNumber searches without role, page role candidates and may return short pages without a distinct business total; a personNumber search with one role reports an exact total. Metadata labels remain in de, fr, or it without translation fallback.

author.description: Substring of the published submitter label, not every co-signatory.

committeeId.description: Committee number from chparl_list_reference topic committees; matches any published committee role.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous call with identical filters; omit to start.

language.description: Metadata language: de (default), fr, or it.

limit.description: Page request, default 20; clamped to 100. Committee pages, and personNumber pages without role, count candidate roles and return each business once, so they may hold fewer businesses.

personNumber.description: Exact member PersonNumber from chparl_search_members, chparl_get_member, a chparl_get_votes member row, or a chparl_search_transcripts passage speaker; former members included. Matches business where that member holds a published role, co-signatures included. Cannot combine with committeeId.

query.description: One title substring, preserving punctuation and diacritics.

role.description: With personNumber only: one role the member holds. author (Urheber/Auteur/Autore), cosignatory (Mitunterzeichner/Cosignataire/Cofirmatario), spokesperson (Sprecher/Porte-parole/Relatore, e.g. for a parliamentary group's business), opponent (Bekämpfer/Opposant/Opposto), or successor (Übernehmer/Repreneur/Assumente, took over a departed author's business). With one role the result reports an exact totalCount; omit role for every role.

sessionId.description: Submission session ID from chparl_list_reference topic sessions.

statusId.description: Current status code from chparl_list_reference topic statuses.

tagId.description: Topic tag ID from chparl_list_reference topic tags, matched as one whole element of the business's pipe-delimited Tags (12 does not match 1216). Without committeeId or personNumber, requires submittedFrom and submittedTo spanning at most 366 inclusive days and reports totalCount on the first page only; if a call runs out of time, retry with a narrower submission window.

typeId.description: Business type code from chparl_list_reference topic business_types.

name: chparl_search_business

businesses.description: Distinct complete business summaries on this page.

items.description: One parliamentary business, preserving sparse source metadata.

businessId.description: Canonical Business.ID as a decimal string.

metadataLanguage.description: Requested metadata row language; no text translation is implied.

sourceUrl.description: Exact HTTPS OData entity URL for this metadata row.

statusDate.description: Current status date with source timezone semantics.

statusId.description: Current business status code, including unknown source codes.

submittedBy.description: Published submitter label; not an exhaustive signatory list.

effectiveFilters.description: Effective business discovery filters and defaults.

cursor.description: Validated cursor supplied for this page.

limit.description: Effective role-candidate or business row limit.

tagId.description: Topic tag ID matched as one whole Tags element.

effectiveLimit.description: Effective business or role-candidate limit after clamping.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incompatible_fields`: submittedFrom is after submittedTo, personNumber is combined with committeeId, or role is supplied without personNumber. `tag_scope_required`: tagId is used without committeeId or personNumber, and without submittedFrom and submittedTo spanning at most 366 inclusive days. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor is malformed, unsupported, or belongs to different filters. `request_too_long`: The text filters make the URL-encoded Parliament request longer than its 2048-byte query-string limit. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Continue after the smallest delivered business ID using identical filters.

notice.description: Combined clamp, short-page, or empty-result guidance.

provenance.description: Attribution, publication status, and source download dates.

officialPublication.description: This server is an unofficial reproduction of the source.

sources.description: Every HTTP response contributing data, or each static source snapshot.

items.description: A source used to produce this result.

retrievedAt.description: Actual UTC download timestamp, or the date of a static source snapshot.

url.description: HTTPS source response or official snapshot document URL.

totalCount.description: Original-filter business total; omitted for author searches, committee searches, personNumber searches without role, and continuation pages of a tagId search without committeeId or personNumber, whose first page carries it.
